_about: Hand-transcribed TDK B3264*B 'High frequency' (MMKP: PP dielectric, double-side metallized PET electrodes) data for c34. Source: TDK MMKP_B32641B_B32643B.pdf, 'B3264*B', June 2026 (6/26), sha256 ab9fdca0b9676c8528b8bb5469d8ec4a60f0983520a65fa8f0517e4b4a58ab77 (not in the repo). p.2: AEC-Q200D, IEC 60384-16 reference, case UL 94 V-0, Top,max 125 C (case), climatic 55/110/56, leads 0.8 mm at 22.5 mm. p.11: 2000 V DC / 500 V AC (f <= 1 kHz) table, I_RMS,max at 85 C / 100 kHz for dT <= 15 C (footnote 8), ESR typ at 85 C / 100 kHz. p.12: tan d <= 1.5e-3 at 100 kHz; service life 200 000 h at VR, 85 C. p.13: dV/dt 3800 V/us, k0 1.5e7 V2/us (2000 V, 22.5 mm). p.24: I_RMS vs f chart (T_A <= 85 C, dT <= 15 C), digitized by scripts/digitize_b32643b.py. p.25: F_T = 1.0 up to 85 C (no extra current at lower ambient). Tolerance codes J (+-5 %) / K (+-10 %). No UL 810 / ENEC component listing found on the sheet.
